<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count the distinct carbon signals that appear in the typical aromatic chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). This count will give the number of aromatic carbons present in the molecule.</thought>
